title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Wendy Chu is a Clinical Instructor at the Harvard Law School Cyberlaw Clinic. Her legal practice is focused on intellectual property, privacy, media law, and nonprofit and startup counseling. Prior to joining the Cyberlaw Clinic, Wendy was a technology transactions associate at Morrison Foerster, where she advised on a broad range of technology, intellectual property, […]
